runtimeInvariants: Needs you has id and label needsYou, and is the first section.
Section ids, row keys, column keys and source ids are unique within their containers.
Every row has exactly the declared columns and references only named sources.
A source without observedAt has unknown freshness, never a claimed age.
All sections declare key order, compared by code unit; collectors sort before rendering.
The content hash is SHA-256 of canonical JSON excluding asOf and the hash itself.
Source strings are scrubbed at snapshot creation and again on each rendered output.
